The analysis failed due to schema mismatches in the assumptions object and missing currency formatting in the summary text.
The test_schema_and_assumptions failed because the output contained 'decision_threshold_usd' and 'currency' instead of the expected 'switch_threshold_usd' and 'patient_override_rule'. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the summary text lacked comma-formatted currency strings (e.g., '-455,619.31'), providing raw floats like '-455619.31' instead. Ensure the output JSON strictly matches the expected keys in /tests/test_outputs.py and the summary markdown includes standard US currency formatting.
